timeline_quoted: 14 Days to build 7 Days of judging 50 Prizes
how_it_works_quoted: 02 Submit your project: Open until Oct 23, 15:00 UTC. One project per team: banner, up to 8,000 characters of description, a demo video (YouTube or Google Drive, keep it to 3 minutes) and your links. Edit or delete it from My Projects anytime.
03 Explore and heart: Every submission shows up in Projects, open one for the full story, demo video included, and heart the ones you love. One heart per project, change it anytime.
04 Judging: Judges score every project after the hackathon ends, your description, demo video and links are what they review. Winners get announced here.

02 Show it: Demo video (required, YouTube or Google Drive)

judging_view_quoted: Gate = NFT essentiality (must pass to qualify). Score each criterion 1-5, total is weighted to 100 (30/20/20/15/15). Tie-breakers: novelty, then retention.
holding_rule: Nothing on the page asks a participant to hold a Chog: the gate is the project's NFT essentiality, judged by the organisers.
consequences: The judging runs about seven days after 23 Oct 15:00 UTC: the app link and the judge access instructions must keep working through that week, so the public instance cannot depend on this Mac and its tunnel.
Judges review the description, the video and the links first: the three-minute video carries the holder path, which only a real Genesis in a real wallet can show.
A judge without a Genesis plays a Genesis through a loan pass (server/README.md), which stops the moment its lender no longer holds the Genesis on chain.
